text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—A ranking feature for drawer-layering 
coords, you say?

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On the day of the event, judges will 
conduct a fashion check, and we're 
planning an on-stage award ceremony for 
the top 10 highest scorers!

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
So—we'd love to ask Flight-san, who is 
well-known as a fashionista, to be our 
judge!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—...Wouldn't that... be disrespectful to 
the outfit?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A Droite outfit is a precious, 
one-of-a-kind creation filled with 
feelings for oneself and one's date—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: For a third party to rank such a thing...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm sorry, I was just curious...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I think planning a project focused on 
Droite coords is a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, there's still time before Droit, 
so the judges can give their response at a 
later date.

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
The project details aren't finalized yet 
either, ...right?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list:
You look pretty down... Did something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing major... Just that I 
briefly felt disappointed in my own 
shortcomings.
choice_data_list:
It looks like a big deal to me. Care to 
talk about it?

It looks like a big deal to me. Care to 
talk about it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, without thinking, I ended up 
saying something totally unnecessary...”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't let go of my stubbornness, and 
I ended up raining on everyone's parade.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even though the committee members put so 
much thought into making this a fun 
Soirée...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Still, no matter what... I—
choice_data_list: ...I think it's great. It suits you.
...I think it's great. It suits you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Like... me?

It's rare for her to put someone else 
first when asked for help and take action. 
However— she holds a deep passion for 
fashion.
choice_data_list:
If it's something precious to you, stick 
to it and charge straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Full... steam—
choice_data_list:
That would be more stylish, don't you 
think?
That would be more stylish, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“...... Right, exactly...... I know that 
better than anyone......”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Unwavering, charging straight down the 
path you believe in. That is the most 
dazzling, peak stylishness—!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, that cleared my head. You are 
right... I too will dash forward, staying 
true to my own policy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First, I'm thinking of coming up with an 
alternative plan for the Droit and 
proposing it to the executive committee.
choice_data_list:
It'd be nice if we could respect each 
other's sense of style.
I hope it brings happiness to everyone.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because that's the one thing I want 
to stay true to.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A precious droit coord carrying 
intertwined feelings— As a fashionista, I 
shall design a project worthy of respect♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, how about a project where, 
instead of ranking, we simply comment on 
the best parts of each participant's 
outfit?”

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
True, everyone should be able to enjoy 
that... Flight-san, I think your plan is 
great!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, how wonderful♪ Cool you and cute 
you, in perfect harmony under a classical 
theme!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So the brooch is a motif of your memories? 
The color and design match your outfit 
wonderfully. It's truly splendid♪

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, it's a huge hit thanks to you! 
People are already asking for us to do it 
again next year...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ When the time comes, please be sure 
to invite me!

text_block_list.name: Droite Participant
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chaaan! Us too! This is our last 
Droit, please...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, please wait a moment...! I'll show 
you in one by one~.
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're overloaded... are you 
okay?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
S-Somehow... I'm really happy we could 
hold an event that respects the true 
essence of coordinates, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If we do the same event next year, we'll 
have to be much better prepared...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fashion is something that brings 
people happiness and gives them courage—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'll come up with an event plan where 
nobody feels sad, and everyone can enjoy 
Droit with a smile♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, how about a project where, 
instead of ranking, we simply comment on 
the best parts of each participant's 
outfit?”

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
True, everyone should be able to enjoy 
that... Flight-san, I think your plan is 
great!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is the theme a message to the senior you 
both look up to? The colors, the motifs... 
I knew the moment I saw it. It'll 
definitely reach her♪

text_block_list.name: Droite Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Really? Yay~! I'm gonna go show it to my 
senpai right now! ...We'll both thank them 
for everything they've done!

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, it's a huge hit thanks to you! 
People are already asking for us to do it 
again next year...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I had a lot of fun too. If there's 
an opportunity next year, I'd gladly 
accept!

text_block_list.name: Droite Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chaaan! Me too, me too~! I want you 
to see my ultimate outfit~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, please wait a moment...! I'll show 
you in one by one~.
choice_data_list: I'll go get the line organized!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... When I check on each and 
every person thoroughly, it inevitably 
ends up taking time...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If we do the same event next year, we'll 
need to figure out a way to keep people 
from waiting so long...!
